limits: Native reference acquisition, invocation overload selection, variable constraints and host context remain PowerShell-owned; this is Hybrid body emission, not runtime-free reference support.

Only unoptimized ordinary local references use actual variable cells; the previously qualified optimized-slot value-copy route remains unchanged. Distinct trailing references, static literal member names and one storage family are required. Scoped/member/alias/early/instance and mixed-storage forms remain hosted.
Runtime static targets qualify only when all references use the native-cell owner; literal targets retain their existing CLR overload-shape guard.
Both Windows hosts are qualified for the observed workflows. No non-Windows, performance, aggregate full-suite, public package or reviewed dependency-lock result is claimed.
The full five-packet census is net10.0 only. No input command or live external administrative/network/installer workflow was executed.
The authored YAML timestamp behavior is preserved, including host-local conversion results; this slice does not correct upstream YAML semantics.
